name: Delivery to the Sepulcher
summary: Delivery to the Sepulcher concludes the fateful journey that brought Sylvanas Windrunner's long-lost necklace to the Undercity. Following an emotional encounter with the Banshee Queen, Ambassador Sunsorrow directs blood elf travelers to ferry sealed orders south into Silverpine Forest. The errand connects elven diplomats in the capital with their field representatives assisting the Forsaken.

sections.title: Diplomatic Footwork
sections.body: After presenting Lady Sylvanas Windrunner with her family heirloom, elven adventurers are swiftly redirected to matters of state. Ambassador Sunsorrow, the sin'dorei emissary stationed within the Royal Quarter, uses the moment to send critical instructions to the field. Rather than remaining amidst the gloomy halls of Undercity, the courier is sent south into Silverpine Forest carrying Sealed Sin'dorei Orders meant for Advisor Sorrelon.

sections.title: A Precarious Alliance
sections.body: The destination is the Sepulcher, a weathered crypt repurposed into the Forsaken's main staging ground in northern Silverpine. For the high-minded sin'dorei, operating out of a dilapidated burial site alongside undead allies is an unsettling reality of their new geopolitical position. Advisor Sorrelon represents Quel'Thalas among these troops, tasked with observing Forsaken military efforts and ensuring blood elf wanderers maintain good conduct to protect their fledgling alliance with the Horde.

faq.q: Why does Ambassador Sunsorrow send me away from Undercity?
faq.answer: Following the stir caused by returning the necklace to Lady Sylvanas, Ambassador Sunsorrow needs sealed instructions carried to Advisor Sorrelon in Silverpine Forest. It serves both as a practical courier duty and a diplomatic posting for blood elf champions eager to prove their worth to the Horde.

aliases: what kind of place is sepulcher
faq.answer: The Sepulcher is a ruined human crypt in northern Silverpine Forest that the Forsaken have turned into a regional command post and outpost. Despite its squalid and decaying appearance, it serves as a central hub for coordinating local defense and supply lines.

Advisor Sorrelon is an elven official stationed at the Sepulcher who represents Quel'Thalas to the Forsaken forces in Silverpine. He manages regional interests and monitors sin'dorei travelers assisting in local military matters.

faq.q: How does Sorrelon view the interaction with Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Sorrelon acknowledges the difficult encounter with Lady Sylvanas, noting that while the Banshee Queen's reaction was cold and haughty, returning her lost necklace was honorable. He warns travelers not to brood over royal temperaments and to focus on maintaining smooth ties with the Horde.

faq.q: What is inside the Sealed Sin'dorei Orders?
faq.answer: The sealed parchment carries Ambassador Sunsorrow's official recommendations and tactical instructions regarding blood elf involvement in Silverpine, noting the adventurer's loyalty and potential as a credit to the sin'dorei.

faq.q: How should a courier travel to the Sepulcher?
faq.answer: The quickest standard path without boarding a flight master's bat is to exit the Undercity through the ruins of Lordaeron, travel west through Tirisfal Glades, and follow the road south into Silverpine Forest past the regional signposts.

angles.text: The delivery highlights the fragile yet burgeoning bond between Quel'Thalas and the Horde, where early diplomatic missions rely heavily on showing deference and cooperation to the Forsaken.
While elven diplomats find places like the Sepulcher squalid and strange, the Forsaken depend on such fortified tombs to hold Silverpine against regional threats.
